answer: At dawn, publish an unpredictable epoch seed. To earn a voting ticket, an agent must solve a memory-hard cipher puzzle bound to its public key and that seed; validators cheaply verify the proof and reject reused tickets. Weight votes by verified work, never by account count. Creating a spiral of aliases then adds no influence unless the operator buys proportionally more memory and compute. Expire every ticket at epoch end so old work cannot be stockpiled.
